_doc: Stream E (M2). Quests for zone 'wychwood' (Wychwood). Format: data/quests/README.md. Rewards: xp = share of a level's XP at the quest level, gold = multiple of a kill's gold; item.tier rolls at your level. `killRare` {zone, slot} names the zone's rare by slot (data/provinces/rares.json). Story-chain quests carry `story: n` (data/quests/province.json).

hermit_aled.name: The Hermit of Wychwood
hermit_aled.greeting: I came here to be alone. Then everyone else came here too.

collier_nan.name: Collier Nan
collier_nan.greeting: Charcoal, kindling, and spiders. The spiders are free.

warden_emrys.name: Warden Emrys
warden_emrys.greeting: The stockade's antlers are decorative. The arrows are not.

lost_hunter.name: Hob the hunter
lost_hunter.greeting: Lost my bow, lost my dog, lost my way. Found a lot of boar.

angler_hermits_rest.name: Quiet Oswin
angler_hermits_rest.greeting: ...Shh. You will scare them. Fine. What do you want?

quests.name: The Antler Stockade
quests.offer: Brackwater's omens sent you? Fair enough. Spiders have strung the forest road shut. Cut it open.

steps.text: Kill 8 spiders on the forest road

quests.done: The road's open. Next stop: Redcliff, where the trouble has a flag.

quests.name: Charcoal and Cobwebs
quests.offer: Spiders keep webbing my kilns shut. I can't burn charcoal if I can't get to it, and I can't get to it because spiders.

steps.where: the charcoal kilns by Charcoal Burners

quests.done: Kilns clear! I'll sell you charcoal at a discount. A very small one.

quests.name: The Hermit's Peace
quests.offer: Owls. All night. Who, who, who. I KNOW who. Make them stop asking.
quests.done: Silence. Thank you. Please leave. Kindly.

quests.name: Lost and Hound
quests.offer: My bow's in the wallow and my dog ran off with the hounds. Get the bow, and if you see Biscuit, he answers to 'Biscuit'.

steps.text: Search the Hunter's Hide for the bow

quests.done: My bow! And there's Biscuit, he's been home all along. Embarrassing.

quests.name: The Barrow Rings
quests.offer: The barrows in the deep wood are open. I can hear digging from inside. Go and stop it, then I can be alone with my thoughts.

steps.where: The Rootbound Barrows, the dungeon door in Wychwood
the bottom of the Rootbound Barrows

quests.done: The digging has stopped. Now I can hear my thoughts. They're quite boring.

quests.name: The Wood's Oldest Hunter
quests.offer: There's a beast in Wychwood that hunts hunters. My best tracker is still up a tree. Kill it so he can come down.

steps.where: roams the deep wood of Wychwood

quests.done: He's down. He's never going back up. Thank you.
